fifa-professional-2023.title: FIFA Professional Football Report 2023
fifa-professional-2023.scope: 2023 men’s professional football; national association coverage and definitions.
fifa-professional-2023.limitations: Two canonical normalized v2 datasets preserve non-null men's professional-player and professional-club counts from all 211 national pages. Missing values remain missing. Extracted national sums differ from FIFA's published global headline and are not altered. Page 38 has a KUWAIT/Kyrgyzstan identity anomaly and must not be auto-mapped.

fifa-big-count-2006.title: FIFA Big Count 2006 — All Players (archived original table)
fifa-big-count-2006.scope: 208 original table rows, association totals, registered/unregistered players, clubs and officials; raw facts in observations/fifa_big_count_2006.csv.
fifa-big-count-2006.limitations: Checked-in normalized observation v2 datasets preserve the 2006 all-player, registered, unregistered, club and officials fields without treating missing cells as zero. The legacy extract is mixed-sex, does not retain per-cell direct/statistically-processed flags, and field definitions are not assumed globally identical. Earth identity reconciliation remains a separate reviewed layer.

aiff-academy-accreditation-2023.title: AIFF — Academy Accreditation Rules and Regulations 2023-24
aiff-academy-accreditation-2023.scope: 2023 nine-tier academy accreditation and youth-development system.
aiff-academy-accreditation-2023.limitations: Regulatory framework does not by itself measure realised academy quality.

aiff-history.title: All India Football Federation — History
aiff-history.scope: Indian federation and national competition history.
aiff-history.limitations: Institutional history is stronger evidence for tradition/competition than national popularity/access.

aiff-isl-grassroots-2014.title: AIFF — Hero Indian Super League to kick off Grassroots Programme in Kolkata
aiff-isl-grassroots-2014.scope: 2014 ISL-linked grassroots development structure and club development staffing.
aiff-isl-grassroots-2014.limitations: Programme launch evidence, not proof of nationwide implementation quality.

caf-senegal-academies-league.title: CAF — Football academies supply Senegal's den
caf-senegal-academies-league.scope: Official CAF account: Génération Foot founded in 2000, Diambars in 2003, professional league launched in 2009, and academy-trained players represented strongly in the national team.
caf-senegal-academies-league.limitations: Academy success is evidence for development pathways; league launch is competition/elite-support evidence. Neither directly measures mass participation.

caf-senegal-member.title: CAF — Senegal member association
caf-senegal-member.scope: Official CAF association record: FSF created in 1960 and affiliated to FIFA and CAF in 1964.
caf-senegal-member.limitations: Association dates are institutional anchors only; they do not directly measure popularity, access, development or competition quality.

caf-south-africa.title: CAF — South Africa member association
caf-south-africa.scope: South African association history and modern affiliation context.
caf-south-africa.limitations: Association milestones alone do not quantify apartheid-era domestic participation.

facr-rfa-2015.title: FAČR — First Regional Football Academy opened in Plzeň
facr-rfa-2015.scope: 2015 launch of the FAČR regional academy model for U14/U15 talent development.
facr-rfa-2015.limitations: Elite youth-development evidence, not a national participation measure.

fifa-india-forward-2019.title: FIFA — Forward reaches new heights in India fostering technical capacity building
fifa-india-forward-2019.scope: 2018-2019 State Development Project, youth competitions and capacity building.
fifa-india-forward-2019.limitations: Programme evidence is stronger for institutional/development direction than for national participation outcomes.

fifa-morocco-academy-2009.title: FIFA — Morocco football academy history (2009 establishment)
fifa-morocco-academy-2009.scope: FIFA article stating Mohammed VI Football Academy was established in 2009.
fifa-morocco-academy-2009.limitations: Other FIFA/Inside FIFA articles describe a 2019 opening of the Mohammed VI Football Academy. The conflict is preserved explicitly; 2009 is only a provisional prototype anchor pending reconciliation of whether the sources refer to different establishment/opening phases.

fifa-morocco-development.title: FIFA — Talent Development Scheme gains new ground in Morocco
fifa-morocco-development.limitations: Primarily modern elite/development evidence. This Inside FIFA source states a 2019 opening of the Mohammed VI Football Academy, while other FIFA articles state establishment/unveiling in 2009; preserve the conflict explicitly.

fifa-senegal-generation-foot-2000.title: FIFA — Fatma Samoura and Senegalese football look to the future in Dakar
fifa-senegal-generation-foot-2000.scope: Official FIFA account stating Génération Foot was founded in 2000 and documenting its training infrastructure and player-development role.
fifa-senegal-generation-foot-2000.limitations: Academy evidence is strong for elite development but does not represent nationwide access or participation.

fifa-senegal-youth-2020.title: FIFA Forward paves way for youth competitions in Senegal
fifa-senegal-youth-2020.scope: 2020 introduction of national U15/U17/U20 youth competition pathways across Senegal's regions.
fifa-senegal-youth-2020.limitations: Programme-launch evidence; supports a structural development/competition-pathway anchor but is not a direct national participation or quality measurement.

fifa-south-africa-history.title: FIFA historical publication — South African football and international exclusion
fifa-south-africa-history.scope: Suspension/expulsion, domestic structures and readmission context.
fifa-south-africa-history.limitations: Historical narrative; numeric ratings remain model estimates.

frmf-history.title: Royal Moroccan Football Federation — History of Moroccan football
frmf-history.limitations: Does not provide a complete annual participation series.

jfa-history.title: Japan Football Association — History
jfa-history.scope: JFA institutional, competition and professionalisation milestones.
jfa-history.limitations: Milestones do not directly measure the six ratings.

sfz-history-1938.title: Slovak Football Association — 1938 foundation history
sfz-history-1938.scope: 1938 Slovak association, independent 1939–45 period and continuity narrative into modern SFZ.
sfz-history-1938.limitations: Historical narrative; later Czechoslovak national totals/results are not automatically Slovak observations.

uefa-czechia-history.title: UEFA — Developing football in Czechia
uefa-czechia-history.scope: Czech football association roots, Czech/Czechoslovak timeline, post-1993 competition and development context.
uefa-czechia-history.limitations: Czechoslovak national-team results are not duplicated as Czech territorial observations; only localisable/inherited tradition context is used.

uefa-faroe-history.title: UEFA — Faroe Islands association history
uefa-faroe-history.scope: Club, competition, association, artificial-turf and UEFA/FIFA history.

uefa-slovakia-hattrick.title: UEFA — Developing football in Slovakia, HatTrick infrastructure
uefa-slovakia-hattrick.scope: 2018–22 youth/grassroots strategy, School Cup participation, 14 artificial pitches and national training centres.
uefa-slovakia-hattrick.limitations: Programme evidence is period-specific and must not be backcast.

uefa-slovakia-hattrick-review.title: UEFA HatTrick Review 2004–2014 — Slovakia
uefa-slovakia-hattrick-review.scope: 100 mini-pitches, ten full-size artificial pitches and grassroots/access infrastructure in Slovakia.
uefa-slovakia-hattrick-review.limitations: Infrastructure evidence does not directly measure elite competition quality.

ussoccer-development-academy-2007.title: U.S. Soccer — Development Academy history
ussoccer-development-academy-2007.scope: Development Academy launched in 2007 to improve elite youth player-development environments.
ussoccer-development-academy-2007.limitations: Elite youth development evidence; not a mass-participation measure.

ussoccer-history-framework.title: U.S. Soccer — History
ussoccer-history-framework.scope: 2003 National Training Center and federation player-development framework.
ussoccer-history-framework.limitations: Federation narrative; does not directly quantify national access or popularity.

ussoccer-national-development-center-201.title: U.S. Soccer — National Development Center grand opening
ussoccer-national-development-center-201.scope: 2018 coaching education, sports medicine and high-performance development facility.

ussoccer-timeline.title: U.S. Soccer — Historical timeline
ussoccer-timeline.scope: Federation, competitions, professional-league and major-event history.
ussoccer-timeline.limitations: Chronology is not a quantitative popularity/access series.

ussoccer-training-center.title: U.S. Soccer — National Training Center groundbreaking
ussoccer-training-center.limitations: Modern evidence only; cannot be backcast.

dfb-history.title: DFB — History: 125 years of the German Football Association
dfb-history.scope: Official DFB timeline including the 1900 association foundation and first German championship in 1903.
dfb-history.limitations: Institutional/competition chronology is strong tradition evidence but does not directly quantify participation, development quality or current competitive strength.

dfb-campus-2022.title: DFB — DFB Campus
dfb-campus-2022.scope: Official DFB account of the Campus in Frankfurt, home of the DFB since June 2022 and its first own sporting infrastructure integrating administration, sport and science.
dfb-campus-2022.limitations: A national-association campus is direct elite/development infrastructure evidence but not a nationwide development-quality or access measurement.

cbf-history-1914.title: CBF — 110 years of history
cbf-history-1914.scope: Official CBF history stating the governing body's foundation on 8 June 1914 and later institutional evolution.
cbf-history-1914.limitations: Federation history supports institutional continuity/tradition but does not directly measure player development or mass participation.

cbf-granja-comary-history.title: CBF — Carlo Ancelotti visits Granja Comary
cbf-granja-comary-history.scope: Official CBF description of Granja Comary as Brazil's national-team training centre, used by the Seleção since 1987.
cbf-granja-comary-history.limitations: National-team training-centre evidence informs elite/development infrastructure but does not describe the full national youth-development system.

cbf-tds-2026.title: CBF — TDS FIFA Development Scheme workshop at Granja Comary
cbf-tds-2026.scope: Official CBF report of the April 2026 FIFA TDS workshop integrating coaches/staff across Brazil's male youth and senior national-team categories with CBF Academy.
cbf-tds-2026.limitations: One programme event shows current development-system activity; it is not proof of nationwide implementation quality or a historical series.

uefa-iceland-history.title: UEFA — Developing football in Iceland
uefa-iceland-history.scope: Official UEFA association history including the 1912 national championship and KSÍ foundation/FIFA affiliation in 1947.
uefa-iceland-history.limitations: Historical milestones support tradition/institutional context but do not directly quantify modern development quality or access.

uefa-san-marino-history.title: UEFA — Developing football in San Marino
uefa-san-marino-history.scope: Official UEFA timeline covering the first club, federation, official competition, youth academy, league and Casa del Calcio.
uefa-san-marino-history.limitations: Timeline milestones are structural evidence; they do not imply numeric rating changes or equal nationwide impact.
